english.title: Run an aircraft engine in a hangar / unauthorised area at Stansted Airport London
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) ran an aircraft engine in

(A)_[a hangar]_
(B)_[an area]_

other than that allocated from time to time for that purpose without permission of the Airport Company or other lawful excuse at Stansted Airport London
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 4(1) and 2(2) of the Stansted Airport - London Byelaws, 1996 and section 63 of the Airports Act 1986.

english.notes: This Byelaw describes an act which is prohibited unless the permission of the Airport Company has first been obtained or unless the act is performed by a person acting with lawful authority or excuse.
